body:
Independent review of PR-2103 recorded at head 0990866f15dd21aaffdd8bd28bbaedb2a6781132 (.aida/review-verdicts/PR-2103.json). All five acceptance criteria met; one binding finding:

1. merge_hold.rs fn reconcile_recusal_route calls sysinfo::System::new_all() once per .aida/agents/*.toml entry that has a pid (65 files here), and it evaluates liveness BEFORE the cheap ended/paused/role filters. This now runs from collect_awaiting_report_inner, i.e. on every aida awaiting render including the per-prompt --notice hook, whenever any recusal hold exists. Required: build one process-only System per call (not new_all), apply ended/paused/role/recusal filters before the pid probe, and add a test/guard that the probe is constructed at most once per call. (Advisor verified the loop shape in the diff; the per-prompt stall magnitude is estimated, not measured.)

Non-blocking: reader selection is lowest-sorted id, not least-loaded, so a newer agent can steal a live route and retire its brief mid-review; the agent: prefix is trusted from AIDA_AGENT_ID without a registry check; a recused operator principal is never matched on clear; retire_stale_route_briefs renames any PR-N-*.md brief, not only route-written ones.
